title: customer-success
text:
customer-success

alex_cs: Heads up — VeraHealth QBR Tue 10am PT. Onboarding ~60% done but we saw a large surge in embedding calls over the last 48h. Projected token/embedding burn looks risky ahead of renewal. Can @irene_finops and @tom_eng help with a quick triage so I can include concrete mitigations in the deck?

alerts-bot: [ALERT] VeraHealth embeddings throughput: 3.6k req/min (48h ↑ 4.3x). Cost spike: +210% vs baseline. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/alerts/vera-embed-171234

irene_finops: quick one-line snapshot — past 24h spend $1,800, rolling forecast w/ current trend ~ $12,500 next 7d. Big tail coming from a recurring reindex + rerank pipeline. I'll prep a short spend breakdown to attach.

tom_eng: possible root cause: customer kicked off a full-corpus similarity reindex overnight. We can reduce token volume by enabling prefix KV caching + dedupe on the embedding route and lowering batch_size. Rough expected drop ~30–40%. Quick config we can push to Dedicated:
```
route: /v1/embeddings
batch_size: 128
cache: prefix_kv
dedupe: true
```
Need a brief restart window; can do a rolling restart to avoid long downtime.

maya_csm: confirming — Vera's ML lead asked support to run a reindex yesterday, they didn't realize it would iterate hourly. I'll ping them to pause the job until we implement gating. Can we do a 30m remediation call tomorrow morning?

sam_successops: action list I captured: 1) alex — update QBR deck with burn + mitigation options, 2) irene — attach spend table + forecast, 3) tom — scope & push config change (or fallback rate-limit), 4) maya — coordinate customer pause and confirm reindex schedule. ETA: EOD tomorrow for first pass.

alex_cs: Thanks — exactly what I need. @tom_eng, please drop the PR/patch link here when available. I'll add a slide comparing current forecast vs mitigated scenario. :thumbsup:

tom_eng: Will do. If cache rollout can't land in time, fallback is to apply a temporary rate-limit to their API key (200 req/min) for 48h and reopen once cache is live.

irene_finops: I'll also set a budget alert at $5k/day for VeraHealth and enable provisional credits notify so CS sees flags immediately.

alerts-bot: [NOTE] Budget alert created for account VeraHealth: threshold $5,000/day (created by irene_finops).

alex_cs: High-level QBR ask: present two remediation paths (1) cache + dedupe + batch tuning, (2) temporary pause + rate-limit; include estimated cost delta and customer impact for each. I'll send invite for a 30m sync and draft the slide.

maya_csm: I'll coordinate with their ML lead and block Wed 11am PT for a short workshop.

alex_cs: Great — looping in product if we'll need a UX comms note for customers when we enable server-side dedupe. For now, moving to action. Thanks everyone.
